# World configuration

This reference describes the packs installed in this build of mineworld; a build with other packs generates a different one (`docs/DECISIONS.md` `ARC-90`). It is generated from the types that read each file, so it is never edited by hand.

Each file under `configure/` other than an Interaction List section ([interaction-list.md](interaction-list.md)): the World Pack format's own, then each System Pack's that takes one.

<a id="configure-classes"></a>

## `configure/classes.yaml`

Read when `world.yaml` lists `classes` under `configure:`.
Read by the World Pack format itself, whatever systems the world enables.

The world's entity classes, in priority order: an entity is in the first class whose type and tag it has, otherwise only in its type's implicit class.

**Type:** list of [ClassDefinition](#configure-classes-classdefinition).

Example:

```yaml
- class: noble
  of: person
  tag: noble
```

### Types used above

<a id="configure-classes-classdefinition"></a>

#### `ClassDefinition`

One entry of `configure/classes.yaml`: entities of type `of` that carry `tag` are in `class`.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `class` | [ClassName](#configure-classes-classname) | yes | — | — | The class being defined; defined once per world. |
| `of` | [EntityType](#configure-classes-entitytype) | yes | — | — | The one entity type it selects among. |
| `tag` | [Tag](#configure-classes-tag) | yes | — | — | The tag an entity of that type must carry to be in the class. |

<a id="configure-classes-classname"></a>

#### `ClassName`

The name of an entity class, such as noble. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _. person, place, item and organization are the implicit classes and cannot be defined.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** 1 to 64 characters; matches `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9_-]*[a-z0-9])?$`.

<a id="configure-classes-entitytype"></a>

#### `EntityType`

One of the four kinds of entity: person, place, item or organization.

**Type:** one of `person`, `place`, `item`, `organization`.

<a id="configure-classes-tag"></a>

#### `Tag`

One label, such as cafe or night-shift. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _, not starting or ending with - or _.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** 1 to 64 characters; matches `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9_-]*[a-z0-9])?$`.

<a id="configure-packages"></a>

## `configure/packages.yaml`

Read when `world.yaml` lists `packages` under `configure:`.
Read by the World Pack format itself, whatever systems the world enables.

The licences the packs this world uses may carry. A pack whose licence expression cannot be satisfied with these identifiers alone is refused by name.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allowed` | list of [Identifier](#configure-packages-identifier) | yes | — | — | The SPDX licence identifiers a pack may carry, replacing the default set: MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, ISC, Zlib, CC0-1.0 and Unlicense. |

Any other key is refused with `unknown field`, naming the key.

Example:

```yaml
allowed:
  - MIT
  - Apache-2.0
  - CC-BY-4.0
```

### Types used above

<a id="configure-packages-identifier"></a>

#### `Identifier`

One SPDX licence identifier, such as MIT, checked against the SPDX licence list.

**Type:** text.

<a id="configure-economy"></a>

## `configure/economy.yaml`

Read when `world.yaml` lists `economy` under `configure:`.
Read by the `economy` system (package `mineworld-economy`), which a world enables in `systems:`.

The file as written.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `price_modifiers` | list of [PriceModifier](#configure-economy-pricemodifier) | no | `[]` | — | Which shops change their prices while which happenings run: at most 32, each (during, shop) once. |

Any other key is refused with `unknown field`, naming the key.

Example:

```yaml
price_modifiers:
  - during: market-day
    permille: 900
    shop: store
```

### Types used above

<a id="configure-economy-entitykey"></a>

#### `EntityKey`

An authoring key: the name of a file in people/, places/, items/ or organizations/ without .yaml. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _, not starting or ending with - or _.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** 1 to 64 characters; matches `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9_-]*[a-z0-9])?$`.

<a id="configure-economy-happeningkindid"></a>

#### `HappeningKindId`

A kind's id: `market-day`, `festival`. The identifier rule of `contracts` (lowercase ASCII letters, digits, `-` and `_`, neither first nor last a separator), at most [`KIND_ID_MAX_BYTES`].

**Type:** text.

<a id="configure-economy-permille"></a>

#### `Permille`

A price multiplier per mille, 100 … 10 000: 900 is 10 % off, 1 500 half as much again.

**Type:** whole number. **Bounds:** 0 to 65535.

<a id="configure-economy-pricemodifier"></a>

#### `PriceModifier`

While a happening of kind `during` runs, the shop at `shop` multiplies its prices by `permille`. `P` is how the shop's place is named: its key in the file, its id once seeded.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `during` | [HappeningKindId](#configure-economy-happeningkindid) | yes | — | — | The happening kind it applies during, by id; matched, never interpreted. |
| `permille` | [Permille](#configure-economy-permille) | yes | — | — | The price multiplier per mille, 100 to 10000: 900 is 10 % off. |
| `shop` | [EntityKey](#configure-economy-entitykey) | yes | — | — | The shop's place, by key. |

<a id="configure-calendar"></a>

## `configure/calendar.yaml`

Read when `world.yaml` lists `calendar` under `configure:`.
Read by the `calendar` system (package `mineworld-calendar`), which a world enables in `systems:`.

The calendar a world keeps: which date the world begins on, its clock's offset from UTC, and where on Earth it is, which sets sunrise and sunset.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `epoch` | [Epoch](#configure-calendar-epoch) | yes | — | — | The local date the world begins on, YYYY-MM-DD, from 1901-01-01 to 2099-12-31. |
| `latitude` | [Latitude](#configure-calendar-latitude) | yes | — | — | Latitude in decimal degrees, north positive, from -90 to 90. |
| `longitude` | [Longitude](#configure-calendar-longitude) | yes | — | — | Longitude in decimal degrees, east positive, from -180 to 180. |
| `utc_offset` | [UtcOffset](#configure-calendar-utcoffset) | yes | — | — | The local clock's fixed offset from UTC, ±HH:MM within ±14:00, such as "-08:00" (no daylight saving). |

Any other key is refused with `unknown field`, naming the key.

Example:

```yaml
epoch: "2026-10-08"
latitude: 32.7157
longitude: -117.1611
utc_offset: "-08:00"
```

### Types used above

<a id="configure-calendar-epoch"></a>

#### `Epoch`

A date written YYYY-MM-DD, such as "2026-10-08" — quoted in YAML — from 1901-01-01 to 2099-12-31.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** matches `^(19|20)[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$`.

<a id="configure-calendar-latitude"></a>

#### `Latitude`

A latitude in decimal degrees, from -90 to 90, north positive.

**Type:** number. **Bounds:** -90 to 90.

<a id="configure-calendar-longitude"></a>

#### `Longitude`

A longitude in decimal degrees, from -180 to 180, east positive.

**Type:** number. **Bounds:** -180 to 180.

<a id="configure-calendar-utcoffset"></a>

#### `UtcOffset`

A fixed offset from UTC, written ±HH:MM such as "-08:00" — quoted in YAML — within ±14:00.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** matches `^[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-5][0-9]$`.

<a id="configure-weather"></a>

## `configure/weather.yaml`

Read when `world.yaml` lists `weather` under `configure:`.
Read by the `weather` system (package `mineworld-weather`), which a world enables in `systems:`.

The weather a world keeps: drawn every day from its climate's rules, or replayed from a weather station's record with the rules filling its gaps.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fill` | [Fill](#configure-weather-fill) | no | — | — | With source record only: what a long gap in the record becomes; rules when unsaid. |
| `record` | [RecordConfiguration](#configure-weather-recordconfiguration) | no | — | — | The record to replay: required with source record, refused otherwise. |
| `rules` | [Rules](#configure-weather-rules) | yes | — | — | The climate: it draws every day with source rules, and fills the record's gaps with source record. |
| `seed` | whole number | yes | — | at least 0 | The seed every drawn day comes from: part of the world, so the same world has the same weather. Not the run's --seed. |
| `source` | [Source](#configure-weather-source) | yes | — | — | Where the days come from: rules (every day drawn from the climate) or record (a station's days replayed). |

Any other key is refused with `unknown field`, naming the key.

### Types used above

<a id="configure-weather-attachment"></a>

#### `Attachment`

A file in the World Pack's data/ directory, written with / on every platform, such as data/weather/station.csv. No \, no drive, no empty, . or .. part; at most 4 MiB.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** matches `^data(/[^/\\:]+)+$`.

<a id="configure-weather-fill"></a>

#### `Fill`

What a run of more than 3 days missing from the record becomes: rules (the rules draw them) or none (the configuration is refused).

**Type:** `rules` or `none`.

- `rules`: The rules draw them.
- `none`: The configuration is refused.

<a id="configure-weather-month"></a>

#### `Month`

One month's climate, every value an integer in its unit; tmin_dc is below tmax_dc.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fog_permille` | whole number | yes | — | 0 to 1000 | The chance of fog on a day, per mille. |
| `overcast_morning_permille` | whole number | yes | — | 0 to 1000 | The chance of an overcast morning on a dry day, per mille. |
| `p_wet_after_dry` | whole number | yes | — | 0 to 1000 | The chance, per mille, that a day is wet when the day before was dry. |
| `p_wet_after_wet` | whole number | yes | — | 0 to 1000 | The chance, per mille, that a day is wet when the day before was wet too. |
| `rain_tenth_mm` | [Quintiles](#configure-weather-quintiles) | yes | — | — | A wet day's rain, as five non-decreasing quintile amounts in 0.1 mm, each from 3 to 10000. |
| `t_ar_permille` | whole number | yes | — | 0 to 999 | How much of yesterday's stray carries into today, per mille. |
| `t_noise_dc` | whole number | yes | — | 0 to 200 | The largest random swing of a day's temperatures from the means, in 0.1 °C. |
| `thunder_permille` | whole number | yes | — | 0 to 1000 | The chance that a wet day has thunder, per mille. |
| `tmax_dc` | whole number | yes | — | -900 to 600 | The mean daily high, in 0.1 °C (215 is 21.5 °C). |
| `tmin_dc` | whole number | yes | — | -900 to 600 | The mean daily low, in 0.1 °C; below `tmax_dc`. |
| `wet_tmax_shift_dc` | whole number | yes | — | -200 to 200 | How much a wet day's high differs from the mean, in 0.1 °C (negative: cooler). |
| `wind_dms` | whole number | yes | — | 0 to 1000 | The mean wind speed, in 0.1 m/s. |
| `wind_from_deg` | whole number | yes | — | 0 to 359 | The direction the wind mostly blows from, in degrees clockwise from north. |

<a id="configure-weather-quintiles"></a>

#### `Quintiles`

Exactly five amounts, in 0.1 mm.

**Type:** list of whole number. **Bounds:** exactly 5 entries.

<a id="configure-weather-recordconfiguration"></a>

#### `RecordConfiguration`

The record a world replays: a station's daily weather, as a file in the World Pack's data/.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | [Attachment](#configure-weather-attachment) | yes | — | — | The record file, made by tools/weather-fetch: a CSV under data/. |
| `first_year` | whole number | yes | — | — | The record year the world's first year replays. |
| `station` | [Station](#configure-weather-station) | yes | — | — | The station the record comes from, for provenance. |

<a id="configure-weather-rules"></a>

#### `Rules`

The climate the weather is drawn from: twelve months of parameters, January first.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `months` | list of [Month](#configure-weather-month) | yes | — | exactly 12 entries | Exactly twelve months, January first. |

<a id="configure-weather-source"></a>

#### `Source`

Where the days come from: rules or record.

**Type:** one of `rules`, `record`.

<a id="configure-weather-station"></a>

#### `Station`

The weather station the record comes from, such as USW00023188: provenance only, printable ASCII.

**Type:** text.

<a id="configure-happenings"></a>

## `configure/happenings.yaml`

Read when `world.yaml` lists `happenings` under `configure:`.
Read by the `happenings` system (package `mineworld-happenings`), which a world enables in `systems:`.

The file as written.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `calendar` | list of [CalendarEntry](#configure-happenings-calendarentry) | no | — | — | Happenings on dates: each names exactly one of weekdays, date and monthday. At most 64. |
| `generators` | list of [SystemId](#configure-happenings-systemid) | no | `[]` | — | External generators this world selects, by system id, each once. |
| `kinds` | list of [RawKind](#configure-happenings-rawkind) | yes | — | — | What may happen, where and at which hours: 1 to 64 kinds, ids unique. |
| `limits` | [Limits](#configure-happenings-limits) | no | `{"per_day":3,"per_place_running":1}` | — | The world's caps on how many happenings begin a day and overlap at a place. |
| `random` | list of [RandomEntry](#configure-happenings-randomentry) | no | `[]` | — | Happenings on a seeded chance per day; each (kind, place) once. At most 64. |
| `seed` | whole number | yes | — | at least 0 | The seed every random draw comes from: part of the world, not the run's --seed. |

Any other key is refused with `unknown field`, naming the key.

Example:

```yaml
calendar:
  - kind: market-day
    place: street
    weekdays:
      - saturday
  - date: "10-31"
    kind: harvest-festival
    place: park
kinds:
  - hours: "08:00-14:00"
    id: market-day
    places:
      - street
    title: Saturday market
  - announce_days: 7
    hours: "16:00-22:00"
    id: harvest-festival
    places:
      - park
  - audience: place
    hours: "11:00-13:00"
    id: street-musician
    places:
      - street
limits:
  per_day: 3
  per_place_running: 1
random:
  - kind: street-musician
    per_mille_per_day: 150
    place: street
seed: 7
```

### Types used above

<a id="configure-happenings-announcedays"></a>

#### `AnnounceDays`

How many days before it begins a happening is announced; 0 announces it at its own midnight.

**Type:** whole number. **Bounds:** 0 to 255.

<a id="configure-happenings-audience"></a>

#### `Audience`

Who hears that a happening began and ended: everybody, or those at its place.

**Type:** `public` or `place`.

- `public`: Heard everywhere.
- `place`: Heard at its place.

<a id="configure-happenings-calendarentry"></a>

#### `CalendarEntry`

A calendar entry as the file writes it: exactly one of `weekdays`, `date` and `monthday`.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `date` | text | no | `null` | — | Every year on this date, MM-DD, such as "10-31". |
| `kind` | [HappeningKindId](#configure-happenings-happeningkindid) | yes | — | — | The kind it schedules, by id. |
| `monthday` | whole number | no | `null` | 0 to 255 | Every month on this day, 1 to 28. |
| `place` | [EntityKey](#configure-happenings-entitykey) | yes | — | — | Where, by key: one of the kind's places. |
| `weekdays` | [WeekdaySet](#configure-happenings-weekdayset) | no | `null` | — | Every week on these weekdays, such as [saturday]. |

<a id="configure-happenings-days"></a>

#### `Days`

How many days a happening runs: from day 1's `from` to day N's `until`.

**Type:** whole number. **Bounds:** 0 to 255.

<a id="configure-happenings-entitykey"></a>

#### `EntityKey`

An authoring key: the name of a file in people/, places/, items/ or organizations/ without .yaml. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _, not starting or ending with - or _.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** 1 to 64 characters; matches `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9_-]*[a-z0-9])?$`.

<a id="configure-happenings-happeningkindid"></a>

#### `HappeningKindId`

A kind's id: `market-day`, `festival`. The identifier rule of `contracts` (lowercase ASCII letters, digits, `-` and `_`, neither first nor last a separator), at most [`KIND_ID_MAX_BYTES`].

**Type:** text.

<a id="configure-happenings-hours"></a>

#### `Hours`

The local hours a happening runs on each of its days, in minutes since midnight: `from` before `until`, both on one day; `24:00` is a legal `until`. Written `HH:MM-HH:MM`.

**Type:** text.

<a id="configure-happenings-limits"></a>

#### `Limits`

The host's own caps (design §5.3), enforced on every draft from every source (INV-WE-6).

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `per_day` | [PerDay](#configure-happenings-perday) | no | `3` | — | The most happenings that may begin on one day, world-wide: 1 to 16, 3 when unsaid. |
| `per_place_running` | [PerPlaceRunning](#configure-happenings-perplacerunning) | no | `1` | — | The most happenings that may overlap at one place: 1 to 4, 1 when unsaid. |

<a id="configure-happenings-monthset"></a>

#### `MonthSet`

A non-empty set of months, written as their numbers: `[5, 6, 7, 8, 9]`.

**Type:** list of whole number.

<a id="configure-happenings-perday"></a>

#### `PerDay`

The most happenings that may begin on one day, world-wide.

**Type:** whole number. **Bounds:** 0 to 255.

<a id="configure-happenings-permille"></a>

#### `PerMille`

A chance per day, per mille: 0 never, 1 000 every day.

**Type:** whole number. **Bounds:** 0 to 65535.

<a id="configure-happenings-perplacerunning"></a>

#### `PerPlaceRunning`

The most happenings that may overlap in time at one place.

**Type:** whole number. **Bounds:** 0 to 255.

<a id="configure-happenings-randomentry"></a>

#### `RandomEntry`

One `random:` entry: the kind, the place, its chance per day, and the weekdays and months it may fire in (all, if not given). `P` is how a place is named.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | [HappeningKindId](#configure-happenings-happeningkindid) | yes | — | — | The kind it draws, by id. |
| `months` | [MonthSet](#configure-happenings-monthset) | no | — | — | The months it may fire in, 1 to 12; every month when unsaid. |
| `per_mille_per_day` | [PerMille](#configure-happenings-permille) | yes | — | — | Its chance per day, per mille: 0 never, 1000 every day. |
| `place` | [EntityKey](#configure-happenings-entitykey) | yes | — | — | Where, by key: one of the kind's places. |
| `weekdays` | [WeekdaySet](#configure-happenings-weekdayset) | no | — | — | The weekdays it may fire on; every weekday when unsaid. |

<a id="configure-happenings-rawkind"></a>

#### `RawKind`

One kind as the file writes it: the catalog entry and its id.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `announce_days` | [AnnounceDays](#configure-happenings-announcedays) | no | `0` | — | How many days before it begins it is announced, 0 to 30; 0 when unsaid. |
| `audience` | [Audience](#configure-happenings-audience) | no | `"public"` | — | Who hears that it began and ended: public (everybody, the default) or place (those there). |
| `days` | [Days](#configure-happenings-days) | no | `1` | — | How many days it runs, 1 to 14; 1 when unsaid. |
| `hours` | [Hours](#configure-happenings-hours) | yes | — | — | The local hours it runs on each of its days, HH:MM-HH:MM, such as "08:00-14:00". |
| `id` | [HappeningKindId](#configure-happenings-happeningkindid) | yes | — | — | The kind's id, such as market-day: 1 to 32 bytes of a-z, 0-9, - and _. |
| `places` | list of [EntityKey](#configure-happenings-entitykey) | yes | — | — | The 1 to 16 distinct places it may happen at, by key. |
| `title` | [Title](#configure-happenings-title) | no | `null` | — | What the kind is called when shown, at most 64 bytes. |

<a id="configure-happenings-systemid"></a>

#### `SystemId`

The id of a System Pack, such as presence or calendar. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _, not starting or ending with - or _.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** 1 to 64 characters; matches `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9_-]*[a-z0-9])?$`.

<a id="configure-happenings-title"></a>

#### `Title`

What a kind is called when it is shown: at most [`TITLE_MAX_BYTES`] of UTF-8 with no control character. Shown, never parsed.

**Type:** text.

<a id="configure-happenings-weekdayset"></a>

#### `WeekdaySet`

A non-empty set of weekdays, written as their names: `[saturday, sunday]`.

**Type:** list of text.

<a id="configure-attributes"></a>

## `configure/attributes.yaml`

Read when `world.yaml` lists `attributes` under `configure:`.
Read by the `attributes` system (package `mineworld-attributes`), which a world enables in `systems:`.

The world's choice of backend, mask, profile, population seed, salt and lock.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `backend` | text | no | `null` | — | The person-generation backend, by id (`ARC-126`). Absent: the only backend the world's packs provide, or none. |
| `format` | whole number | yes | — | at least 0 | The format version: 1. |
| `lock` | text | no | `null` | — | The lock, by name: `locks/<name>.yaml` of this World Pack. |
| `mask` | text | no | `null` | — | The mask applied to the backend's catalogue, by id. Absent: the backend's default. |
| `profile` | text | no | `null` | — | The population profile people are sampled from, by its `profile:` id among the world's and its required packs' `populations/` files. Absent: no sampling. |
| `salt` | whole number | no | `0` | at least 0 | Changes sampled values only; the world's own population is the one this salt gives. |
| `seed` | text | no | `null` | — | The population seed: world content, never the run's `--seed`. Required when `profile` is set. |

Any other key is refused with `unknown field`, naming the key.

Example:

```yaml
backend: mineworld
format: 1
lock: cast
mask: core
profile: san-diego-county
salt: 0
seed: fixture-pop-v1
```
